name: Pest Control Information Sheet and Signs from Applicator
description: Before any treatment, the applicator supplies the Pest Control Information Sheet and required signs so the District can meet its posting and notice requirements.
preparedBy: Certified applicator or pesticide application technician
deadline: prior to performing any treatment, with sufficient time for 72-hour notices
quote: Prior to performing any treatment, the applicator or technician must supply a Pest Control Information Sheet and all required pest control signs at least 8 ½” by 11” in size to the Superintendent or designee so that the Superintendent or designee has sufficient time to comply with all posting and notification requirements as outlined in this Administrative Guideline.
